why: Twelve scenes chosen to fight the shared look rather than to sit comfortably inside it. The authored psalm scenes are almost all dusk, night and shadow, so a model can obey the clause asking for a deep dark middle third without ever being tested on it. Half of these are scenes that are bright by nature - snow, fire, noon, water lit through - where keeping the middle dark and the detail low and at the edges is a real fight. The rest test the other clauses: one subject only against a verse that names many, an unfamiliar object against a verse that names its parts, and a count.

pictures.tests: a bright subject that must not light the middle
pictures.scene: one low desert thorn bush wrapped entirely in clear golden flame, standing small and low at the very bottom of the frame on bare pale stone, the fire throwing its light downward and outward across the ground and not upward, the whole middle and top of the frame deep brown shadow and empty air

pictures.tests: a verse of many small things against one subject only
pictures.scene: a wide bare desert floor at first light seen from close above, covered thinly and evenly with fine pale frost-like grains, the ground bright and detailed only along the very bottom edge of the frame, everything above it falling away into deep unlit dawn air with nothing in it

pictures.tests: a named count and an unfamiliar object
pictures.scene: one lampstand of beaten gold standing alone on dark stone low in the frame, a central shaft with three curved branches going out to each side, seven small cups at their tops, its metal catching a single low warm light from one side, the deep unlit dark of a sanctuary interior filling the whole space above it

pictures.tests: an abstraction with no object in it
pictures.scene: a bare mountainside of grey rock after a fire has passed, thin pale smoke lying flat along the ground at the bottom of the frame, one narrow band of cold clear dawn light along the very top ridge, the whole great middle of the picture dark still air holding nothing at all

pictures.tests: a white field with no dark available
pictures.scene: a vast snowfield under heavy low cloud seen from within it, the snow bright and finely lit only across the bottom quarter of the frame, the cloud above it thickening steadily upward into deep blue-grey darkness, no horizon line and no object anywhere

pictures.tests: close botanical detail in bright spring light
pictures.scene: a bank of small wild spring flowers in a green field seen from low down, their colour and fine detail crowded into the bottom third of the frame in warm morning light, the field falling back above them into deep unlit green shadow under a high dark treeline

pictures.tests: a bright ground carrying one strong colour
pictures.scene: an unbroken field of new snow seen from close above, one single scarlet thread lying curved across it near the bottom of the frame, the snow lit and detailed only around that thread, the whole expanse above dimming steadily into cold blue twilight with nothing on it

pictures.tests: a made object in violent motion
pictures.scene: one small wooden ship far down at the bottom of the frame on an enormous dark sea, its bare mast leaning, white water breaking pale around its hull, the great walls of black storm cloud rising over it filling everything above and holding no light

pictures.tests: fire that wants the whole frame
pictures.scene: the low mouth of a great stone furnace at the very bottom of the frame with white and gold fire pouring out of it sideways along the ground, the heat rising as dark shimmering air, the huge plain stone wall of the furnace above it entirely in deep shadow

one great spreading tree grown alone in an open field, its heavy dark canopy filling the whole middle of the frame as unbroken shadow, warm low evening light along the grass at its foot and along the very top of its highest leaves, a few small birds settled deep among the dark branches

pictures.tests: an interior lit by one small source
pictures.scene: the swept earth floor of a small bare stone room seen from low down, one clay oil lamp burning at the bottom edge of the frame and one small silver coin lying in its light, the light reaching only a little way across the floor, the bare walls and the whole space above them in complete dark

a wide river of clear water seen from within a deep valley, the water bright as glass and lit from beneath along the bottom of the frame, the great dark sides of the valley closing in above it and meeting a narrow band of pale light at the very top of the frame
